notes:
Add product-grounded design direction, human-expectation handoffs and Thinking Orbs guidance, and make public UX hooks portable across Codex and Claude.

Preserve the completed audit learnings without claiming that collection of the unchanged UX Design Studio bridge includes its separately installed backend.

2026-10-20 efficient implementation integration: Prevent code minimization from dropping comprehension, meaningful states, recovery or accessibility.

2026-10-20 portable workflow and review evidence: Keep essential action/state copy visible while making missing native setup distinct from failed design review.

2026-10-27 release review: Tie design choices to the user’s actual question, domain and interaction expectations.

BACKEND-ONLY PENDING: canonical UXHC changes include optional-HIL agent-only full-report guidance; direct-entry route and meaningful-state coverage; 14 heuristic cards and supplied surface scores; actual supplied reviewer provenance; untruncated evidence-linked findings; internal report navigation and collapsed supplemental/evidence sections; optional private local brand binding; reusable authorized-remediation prompt; scalar evidence-limit normalization; and HTML-first large-PDF rendering with truthful fallback status. The final method pass adds a default sampled-score caveat so high grades do not imply release or accessibility clearance. These changes are in the recipient-bound UXHC source, not the plugin package. Site-specific branding, navigation, product and application defects remain with their application owners. No backend source, private branding, evidence, screenshots or configuration was copied into public package inputs. The three historical external UXHC artifacts are frozen-legacy entries and are not current plugin collection targets.

2026-10-15 hook ownership and naming: Use Track frontend review tasks and Check frontend review completion for the opted-in edit/closeout hooks.

2026-10-20 efficient implementation integration: Added a full conditional human-expectations method: audience/task, entry-to-completion journey, meaningful states, usability/accessibility, evidence versus assumptions, exclusions and rendered return review. Product business facts stay with Work Management.

2026-10-20 portable workflow and review evidence: UX writing adds progressive disclosure and final Humanizer handoff. Runtime now distinguishes an intentionally absent source-only engine from non-executable mode, names local reviewed setup guidance, and keeps all fail-closed integrity checks. Public projection also removes redundant explicit Claude hook registration; canonical UX already uses the single shared default declaration.

2026-10-27 release review: Add conditional distinctive-direction and implementation-expectation references, task routing and Thinking Orbs integration guidance. The newer local Motion Anything recipe and source-record bundle remains held for redistribution review. Refine dashboard comparison, copy handoffs, complete UXHC report/attribution checks, specialist policies and source-only native-runtime setup diagnostics. This extends the earlier backend-only note with current client-side methods. The new local motion-recipe catalog remains outside this public edition because its source manifest retains a redistribution hold. This release preserves the prior complete public motion-and-performance method; it does not claim the held catalog is bundled. Claude hook declarations use one automatic handler set with a portable host-root fallback.

Compatibility: Version 0.5.0 retains existing UX skill IDs and recipient-owned optional backend and native-engine bindings. The public Claude manifest uses automatic hooks/hooks.json discovery; shared commands resolve the installed Codex or Claude root without duplicate handler registration. Private backend source, evidence and branding are excluded. The complete previous public motion-and-performance method remains available; the newer local Motion Anything recipe and source-record bundle remains held for redistribution review. Thinking Orbs guidance adds no runtime, provider, installer or claim of successful completion.

Upgrade: Do not represent plugin collection as delivery of these backend changes. A fresh backend connection loads locally updated source. Backend distribution requires its own existing release process and explicit future authorization; it remains separate from this plugin release.

2026-10-20 efficient implementation integration: Refresh local UX Design Studio. Reuse existing source/rendered evidence, components and scope rather than introducing a mandatory redesign phase.

2026-10-20 portable workflow and review evidence: Refresh source; acquire the exact reviewed runtime overlay only when native commands are needed. Do not substitute current host paths or arbitrary engines.

2026-10-27 release review: Refresh the package and use only the direction/motion branch needed. Obtain a matching reviewed runtime overlay only for the optional native engine, then verify actual rendered states and interactions.

Validation: Fresh read-only source-inventory comparison found no canonical/public ux-design-toolkit package diff at recorded version 0.4.1. Actual installed-launcher backend checks generated full and partial HTML/PDF, including the large portfolio PDF without fallback. Final completeness suite: 148 passed with two URL-capture tests excluded; focused route/state startup regression passes. Browser checks verified 14 cards, 28 findings, 38 evidence images, exact internal navigation, scrolling captures, copy and manual fallback. Private outputs are excluded from backend release inputs.

2026-10-15 hook ownership and naming: Native discovery confirms both hooks enabled/trusted with their previous events, matcher and timeouts.

2026-10-20 efficient implementation integration: Two changed UX skill heads and all changed relative links validate; installed bytes verified. This change is procedural; no new UI or participant-research validation is claimed.

2026-10-20 portable workflow and review evidence: 19 canonical and 19 projected adapter tests pass. Source-only and permission failures return 1; verified native overlay and real palette help return 0. Two native hook cases show exactly one UX PostToolUse/Stop response. Native Codex parity and focused discovery verified.

2026-10-27 release review: The release scope record and current public/canonical source differences were reviewed read-only for this note. Applicable added specialist policy files were checked for allow_implicit_invocation: false. Package structural, provenance/license closure, focused runtime tests, privacy checks and publication readback remain release-gate checks; this note does not claim those checks passed or establish live runtime readiness. Read-only local_sync.reviewed_additions passed for all 13 listed exact-canonical additions, checking public/canonical byte equality, source-inventory membership, provenance hashes and license coverage. This does not establish full package or runtime validation. Native Claude 2.1.280 strict validation and Claude-only environment command smoke checks passed for the reviewed hook projection; live conversation dispatch was not exercised.
